title: Implementation Status Snapshot - Playbook (Customer Rollouts)
summary: Lightweight template / working playbook to capture a single-customer implementation status snapshot for inference rollouts. Focused on milestones, owners, blockers, mitigation, and renewal touchpoints. Intended for weekly CS syncs and QBR prep. Not a full project plan (keep short).
purpose_and_scope: Purpose: provide a one-page working snapshot for the CS lead, solutions engineer, and customer PM to align on next actions. Scope: Redwood inference rollouts (hosted, dedicated, private) — covers infra prep, model onboarding, perf validation, and go-live readiness.
milestones: M1 - Kickoff & Alignment | Owner: Aisha Patel | ETA: 2025-09-18 | Status: Done | Notes: SOW executed, initial success criteria agreed.
M2 - Network & Security Review | Owner: Luis Romero | ETA: 2025-10-02 | Status: Done | Notes: VPC peering plan approved; KMS integration scheduled.
M3 - Capacity Reservation (Dedicated) | Owner: Ethan Morales | ETA: 2025-10-16 | Status: In progress | Notes: GPU pool reserved, pending autoscale policy validation.
M4 - Model Import & Verification | Owner: Solutions Eng | ETA: 2025-11-01 | Status: In progress | Notes: 2/3 models imported; quantized variant failing eval on long-tail prompts.
M5 - Performance & Cost Baseline | Owner: Eng-SRE | ETA: 2025-11-15 | Status: Planned | Notes: baseline token cost and p95 latency to be published in console.
M6 - Canary Traffic & Observability | Owner: Claire Nguyen | ETA: 2025-11-29 | Status: Planned | Notes: rollout policy, traces, and alert thresholds defined.
M7 - Go-Live (soft) | Owner: Customer PM | ETA: 2025-12-10 | Status: Planned | Notes: limited users, rollback policy in place.
M8 - Post-Go-Live Review & Optimization | Owner: Aisha Patel | ETA: 2026-01-10 | Status: Planned | Notes: optimize batching, enable prefix cache where effective.
M9 - Renewal / Commercial Review | Owner: Customer Success Manager | ETA: 2026-10-01 | Status: Planned | Notes: tie SLA and observed unit economics to renewal conversation.
open_blockers: Blocker 1: Quantized model variant failing hallucination regression for long-tail prompts | Impact: blocks M4 verification and delays canary | Mitigation: rollback to fp16 variant; schedule model patch with Applied ML team (A/M 2 weeks)

Blocker 2: KMS policy requires corporate legal approval (customer side) | Impact: prevents private deployment keys from being onboarded | Mitigation: CS to coordinate legal introduction thread and provide KMS RBAC template; escalate to account exec if >10 business days

Blocker 3: Observability retention limits (customer budget) conflict with debug needs | Impact: reduces ability to triage intermittent latency spikes | Mitigation: enable targeted token-level tracing for 72h windows only; propose short-term paid retention bump for go-live window
risks_and_assumptions: Risk: Model drift during first month of production causing quality regressions — Assumption: Automated eval hooks will catch regressions before they impact SLAs.
Risk: Capacity contention during marketing event — Assumption: autoscale and burst capacity will cover 3x baseline for 4 hours.
Risk: Customer engineering bandwidth constraints — Assumption: Solutions Eng will provide extended office hours for the first two weeks of canary.

weekly_checklist: 1) Confirm milestone owners updated and ETA still valid
2) Surface any new blockers and assign mitigations
3) Pull latest perf/cost baseline from Redwood Console and attach to snapshot
4) Verify canary metrics (p50/p95 latency, token cost, error rate) meet thresholds
5) Update runbook with recent postmortem notes if any incidents occurred
renewal_touchpoints: T-180: Begin commercial thread and preliminary usage review (owner: CSM)
T-90: Present engagement health in QBR; show cost/unit trends and SLO adherence
T-30: Share renewal offer; propose committed capacity if cost volatility observed
Post-renewal: Schedule scaling & optimization workshop with Optimize team
escalation_path: 1) CS Lead (Aisha) -> 2) Head of Customer Success -> 3) Account Executive -> 4) VP of Sales / Eng if SLA breach or legal impasse. Use #cs-escalations Slack channel and include ticket refs (JIRA) for audit.
notes_and_tips: Tips: prefer short, actionable lines. When preparing for QBR, export 2 slides: (a) one-line health summary + top 3 asks, (b) milestone timeline with color-coded risk. Keep technical details in linked artifacts, not in the snapshot.
